description: Source code for Azure AVA (Cognitive Services) Text-to-Speech transformation, mapping OpenAI TTS specifications to Azure Cognitive Services TTS API, including configuration, URL handling, SSML generation, and parameter mapping.

classes.name: AzureAVATextToSpeechConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure AVA Text-to-Speech, handling URL construction, SSML transformation, parameter mapping, and environment validation.

methods.name: dispatch_text_to_speech
methods.description: Handles Azure-specific credential resolution and dispatches TTS requests.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns list of OpenAI parameters supported by Azure TTS.

methods.name: _convert_speed_to_azure_rate
methods.description: Converts OpenAI speed parameter to Azure SSML prosody rate percentage.

methods.name: _build_express_as_element
methods.description: Builds mstts:express-as SSML element with optional style, styledegree, and role attributes.

methods.name: _get_voice_language
methods.description: Determines the xml:lang attribute for the voice element based on voice name and explicit language.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI TTS parameters to Azure-specific parameters, including voice, format, speed, and SSML options.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and sets up authentication headers for Azure environment.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for Azure TTS API based on provided api_base, handling endpoint conversions.

methods.name: _is_cognitive_services_endpoint
methods.description: Checks if hostname is a Cognitive Services endpoint.

methods.name: _is_tts_endpoint
methods.description: Checks if hostname is a TTS endpoint.

methods.name: _extract_region_from_hostname
methods.description: Extracts region code from hostname for endpoint URL construction.

methods.name: _build_tts_url
methods.description: Builds the TTS URL with specified region.

methods.name: is_ssml_input
methods.description: Detects if input string is SSML based on presence of <speak> tags.

methods.name: transform_text_to_speech_request
methods.description: Transforms plain text or SSML input into Azure-compatible SSML request data.

methods.name: transform_text_to_speech_response
methods.description: Wraps Azure TTS response audio data into a standard response format.
